info.title: Synthetic invoice billing events
info.description: The accepted message contract of the synthetic invoice application (FIX-ASYNC-1). A reminder request is published from the outbox by the relay and consumed by the reminder worker.

reminderRequested.description: Reminder requests, routed to the reminder worker's queue.

reminderDead.description: Where a reminder request that cannot succeed ends: a payload that does not conform, a tenant the invoice does not belong to, or the delivery limit reached.

requestReminder.summary: The outbox relay publishes, with a publisher confirm, after the transaction that wrote the request committed.

handleReminder.summary: The reminder worker writes one reminder and one notification per business key, then acknowledges.

x-delivery.publication: a publication counts once the broker confirmed it; a lost confirm is republished from the outbox with the same messageId

metadata.messageId: every publication carries the logical message id (the payload's messageId) as the transport's own message id
metadata.causationId: the executionRef of the job execution that requested the reminder

x-delivery.consumerIdempotentBy: businessKey (tenantId|invoiceId|occurrenceId): a redelivered or duplicated message leaves one reminder and one notification
x-delivery.retry: a delivery that fails is redelivered after a backoff of 250 ms times its delivery attempt, which is the consumer's own count of the deliveries of that message id
